title: rubus gracilis var. microcarpus
intro: Rubus gracilis var. microcarpus, commonly known as the dwarf Himalayan raspberry, is a type of raspberry plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its edible fruits and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Rubus gracilis var. microcarpus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties, which can help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic agent, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ellagic acid.
